board_identity: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK — one pick per game
unified_rule: ONE pick per game: for each slate date, DiamondEdge locks one simple four-analyst rule chosen from strictly prior games in trailing 14/21/28 day windows. Candidate rules follow or fade analyst majorities, unanimous desks, individual analysts and agreeing analyst pairs; rules that do not fire pass the game. The selected rule is chosen by net wins with minimum sample, hit-rate and pick-rate filters, then applied to that date's games without using same-day or future results. analysts.persona_line: The number is the evidence, so I grade the market and nothing else: where it opened, how far it moved, how much the books disagree and what the two sides actually cost.

analyst_desk_spec.positioning: THE ANALYST DESK (Leon, 2026-07-30): the home screen is a competition — four named analysts, each a real graded engine, call every game; the desk states its consensus and DiamondEdge synthesizes the final frame. SEMANTICS (2026-07-31): the frame follows THE BET, not the vote — a served bet reads PLAY or LEAN by its star tier, a game with no served bet reads AVOID, and the desk's agreement or disagreement is rendered alongside as context. The desk weights its analysts by a nightly rolling 30-day fit of their disagreement with the price (chief.desk_fit), which falls back to equal weighting — and says so — whenever the fit cannot beat equal weighting walk-forward, which is the state today. The underlying pick machinery, every record, and every honesty rail are UNCHANGED underneath.

rolling_desk_fit.headline: Fitting the four analysts' disagreement-with-the-price over a rolling 30-day window does NOT beat weighting them equally: walk-forward over 211 games and 16 days the log-loss difference is -0.00027 (95% CI [-0.00140, +0.00076]). The desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS. Neither is the combined desk distinguishable from simply using the price.
rolling_desk_fit.model: P(over) = sigmoid( logit(p_mkt) + b + SUM_a w_a * d_a ), d_a = logit(p_over_a) - logit(p_mkt_a), 0 where analyst a has no read. The market log-odds are a FIXED OFFSET, so w_a asks only whether that analyst's disagreement with the number adds anything the number does not already carry. Ridge-penalised (lambda pre-specified, not scanned), fit by IRLS, standard errors from the penalised Hessian.
rolling_desk_fit.baselines: EQUAL WEIGHT = the same model with one shared coefficient on the mean divergence of the analysts who read the game, fit on the same window — so the comparison isolates differential weighting. MARKET = p_mkt untouched.
caveats: THE CORPUS RESTARTED ON 2026-07-01 AND THAT IS THE POINT. This block used to be computed over ~11,800 games of a pre-re-architecture reconstruction of four DIFFERENT models. Those weights could never have been applied honestly to these analysts, so the history was dropped rather than carried forward. What is here now is a few hundred games and it says so; a thin honest window beats a deep irrelevant one.

Almost every frame is `reconstructed_oos` basis: the four models were built on 2026-07-31 and priced July after the fact. Every read is genuinely out of sample against a 2026-06-30 training fence, but it was not SERVED before the game. The live share grows by one slate a night and nothing is ever restated.

THE EVIDENCE FLOOR IS MET AND THE WALK-FORWARD IS NOT. The trailing window now clears both floors, so four weights CAN be fitted — but the walk-forward that decides whether to USE them only starts once 150 games of history exist, which on a corpus this young costs the first half of it. So the contrast is scored on a handful of slates and its interval is wide enough to contain both a real improvement and a real regression. Adopting weights on it would be adopting noise; the gate stays shut and the interval is printed rather than described.

No analyst shows a positive edge on its own side and none is claimed (the four sit between 43% and 51% at n=332, an interval of about +/-5.4 points). What the re-architecture bought is DECORRELATION — disjoint feature slices, side agreement down from 0.84-0.89 to 0.51-0.57 — which is the property a combiner would need in order to have anything to combine. Whether it carries edge is a question only the forward record answers.
rolling_desk_fit.honest_note: THE ROLLING DESK FIT IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. It re-fits every night over the trailing 30 days how each analyst's DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PRICE has related to results, scores that fit WALK-FORWARD (fit strictly on days before the day it is scored on, never on the days it is scored on), and compares it to two baselines: equal weighting and the price itself. Fitted weights are only ever ADOPTED when the walk-forward improvement over equal weighting has an interval strictly better than zero AND the window carries enough reads to fit four weights. When it does not — which is the state today — the desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS and this block says so with the numbers, because presenting a fitted weight whose interval straddles the equal-weight baseline is presenting noise as insight. Nothing here gates, sizes or grades a bet: the +EV gate and the star system remain the only things that make a bet, and the combined probability is display only, graded nowhere.

vega.title: THE PRICE
vega.thesis: The number is the evidence, so I grade the market and nothing else: where it opened, how far it moved, how much the books disagree and what the two sides actually cost.
vega.note: VEGA is the ONLY analyst for which the market is a model input. It is also the only one that prices a PROBABILITY rather than projecting a total: its model is a residual on logit(de-vigged market probability), which is what a market reader actually does.
vega.formula: logit(p_over) = logit(p_market) + -0.0542 +0.0000*z[line_move] +0.0000*z[move_pace] -0.0030*z[time_since_move] +0.1270*z[book_disagreement] -0.0494*z[price_dispersion] +0.0169*z[sharp_gap] +0.0263*z[n_books] -0.0664*z[stale_gap]   ;   side = over if p_over > p_market else under

atlas.title: THE CONDITIONS
atlas.thesis: Runs are a physical event, so I grade the place and the man behind the plate: the park's run factor, its altitude and roof, day or night, and how many runs this umpire's games actually produce.
atlas.note: WEATHER IS NOT IN THIS SLICE AND THAT IS A DATA FACT, NOT A CHOICE: wx_* fill is 0.356 in 2025 and 0.006 in 2026, and what exists is ERA5 proxy_ablation which house policy excludes from every clean variant. ATLAS's environment is park + altitude + roof + day/night + umpire run tendency. If a real forward weather feed ever lands, wx_* is the first thing that belongs here.
atlas.formula: delta_runs = (+0.2723*z[park_run_factor] +0.2801*z[park_altitude] -0.1607*z[park_roof] +0.0000*z[is_night] +0.0970*z[ump_runs] -0.0321*z[ump_strikeouts] +0.0000*z[ump_walks]) - -0.0044   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.537)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

nova.title: THE BATS
nova.thesis: Runs come from bats, so I grade the hitters and nothing else: the nine names actually posted tonight against the hand they will face, and how the two offenses have actually been scoring.
nova.note: NOVA's lineup-vs-hand feature is computed by the enrich layer against the opposing starter's throwing HAND. A hand is an IDENTITY, not a quality: no measure of how good that pitcher is ever reaches NOVA, and no `sp_*` column is in its slice.
nova.formula: delta_runs = (+0.0000*z[bats_vs_hand] +0.0000*z[bats_top5_vs_hand] +0.0000*z[bats_woba] +0.1977*z[bats_top5_woba] +0.2454*z[bats_power] +0.0000*z[bats_onbase] +0.0000*z[bats_scoring_form] +0.0000*z[bats_strikeouts] -0.0379*z[bats_lineups_known]) - 0.0156   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.549)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

scout.title: THE ARMS
scout.thesis: Runs come from bad pitching, so I grade the arms and nothing else: the two starters who open the game and the bullpens behind them — weak staffs mean runs, and I lean over.
scout.formula: delta_runs = (+0.0000*z[sp_fip] +0.1631*z[sp_contact_quality] +0.0324*z[sp_worst_contact_quality] +0.1385*z[sp_recent_form] +0.0000*z[sp_worst_recent_form] -0.0752*z[sp_length] -0.1031*z[sp_groundballs] -0.0427*z[sp_rest] +0.2010*z[pen_era] +0.0000*z[pen_worst_era] +0.0000*z[pen_workload] +0.0000*z[pen_worst_workload] +0.0000*z[pen_back_to_back] +0.0000*z[pen_closer_available]) - 0.0316   ;   p_over = Phi(delta / 4.546)   ;   side = over if delta > 0 else under   ;   projected total shown = posted line + delta   [context-free absolute projection, diagnostic only: mu_absolute = 8.9160 + the same linear term]

analyst_v2_spec.chief_contract: THE ANALYST-STREAM CONTRACT (v2, 2026-07-31) — what the desk chief may rely on. SOURCE: v4/serve/analyst_v2_stream.reads_for_date(date) -> {game_pk: {analyst_key: read}}, read-only over the write-once board at v4/serve/state/analyst_v2_board.json. GUARANTEES: (1) at most ONE read per (date, game_pk, analyst), written once and never restated — a key already on the board is skipped, not overwritten; (2) every read carries `pick_side` in {over, under} (a read with no side is never written), `p_over` in (0,1), `market_line`, `p_mkt_over` and `edge_vs_market`; (3) the three CHANNEL analysts (scout/nova/atlas) additionally carry `delta_runs` (their signal in runs, positive = over), `center_used` (the strictly-prior trailing centre that delta is measured against), `conviction_runs` = |delta_runs|, `mu_shown` = market_line + delta_runs (the total that analyst projects for THIS game, coherent with the line by construction) and `mu_absolute` (its context-free projection, diagnostic only); VEGA carries `delta_runs`: null because it prices a probability, and its signal is `edge_vs_market`; (4) `top_drivers` is the three levers contributing most to that read, each with its z, its beta and its contribution IN RUNS — safe to render verbatim; (5) `basis` is 'reconstructed_oos' or 'live' and `trained_through` is the training fence, so the chief can weight by evidence type; (6) `is_bet` is ALWAYS false — these are reads, and the served product pick is not built from them. DECORRELATION: the four slices are disjoint and enforced by analyst_v2.slices.FeatureGate, so the chief may treat the four reads as carrying independent information about different causal channels — that is the design property a combiner should exploit. STABILITY: adding a field is allowed; removing or renaming one is a contract break and must be announced.
analyst_v2_spec.wall_contract: THE PER-WALL ANALYST CONTRACT (2026-07-31). SOURCE: v4/serve/analyst_v2_walls.reads_for_wall(date, wall) and timeline_for_date(date), read-only over a WRITE-ONCE store at v4/serve/state/analyst_v2_wall_board.json. GUARANTEES: (1) at most ONE row per (date, game_pk, analyst, wall), written once and never restated; (2) the T-3h wall is NOT in this store — it is owned by analyst_v2_stream's board, which record.analysts is graded from, and reads_for_wall delegates to it so there is exactly one T-3h read per game; (3) EVERY ANALYST FILES A READ WITH A SIDE ON EVERY GAME THAT HAS A DECISION ROW AND A POSTED TOTAL AT THAT WALL (2026-08-01). The evidence floor that used to empty a seat on thin inputs is retired: a lever whose information has not landed takes its NEUTRAL value, contributes exactly 0.00 runs to the deviation, and the analyst files on the rest of its slice. The only remaining empty seat is `no_market` — no posted total, so there is no number to have an opinion about, and it still carries a `reason_code` and a sentence; (4) every read publishes `information_completeness` (the share of the wall model's own |beta| mass genuinely read), `completeness_tier`, `levers_neutral_filled`, `completeness_note` and `confidence_scale` = sqrt(completeness), and its probability is scaled by that — so a read built on less information carries LESS CONVICTION, not the same conviction with a caveat. At completeness 1 the scale is exactly 1 and the read is bit-for-bit the fully-informed one; (5) `top_drivers` NEVER contains a lever that was not read, so no read can cite information it did not have — that lock is UNCHANGED and is what keeps this from being FORCED COVERAGE, WHICH REMAINS RETIRED and cannot be produced by this module; (6) every row carries `wall`, `in_wall_window`, `basis` (live_wall / reconstructed_wall), `information_read`, `information_missing`, `information_not_yet_possible`, `lineup_posted`, `umpire_assigned` and `starters_announced`; (7) `is_bet` is ALWAYS false and nothing here touches games[].pick, record.headline_champion_v2 or record.analysts. THE MODELS: one fit per (analyst, wall) over exactly the levers whose information exists at that wall, fenced at 2026-06-30 like every other analyst model. The T-3h wall fit reproduces the SHIPPED T-3h artifact to 1e-9, which is what proves this is the same engine walked back through the day rather than a second one.

completeness.note: EVERY ANALYST FILES ON EVERY GAME AT EVERY WALL (2026-08-01). A lever whose information has not landed takes its NEUTRAL value and contributes exactly zero to the deviation; the read stands on the rest of the slice. What used to be an evidence FLOOR is now a MEASUREMENT: `information_completeness` is the share of the model's own |beta| mass that was genuinely read, it is published on every read, and the read's confidence is scaled by its square root — so a read built on less information is a less confident read rather than an absent one. A neutral-filled lever still cannot be cited, by `citable_drivers` and by the take library's information gate, which is what keeps this from being the retired forced-coverage mechanism in a new coat.

reason_codes.no_frame: no decision row exists for this game at this wall yet — the wall has not been crossed or the collector has not reached it
reason_codes.no_market: no consensus total is posted for this game at this wall, so there is no number to price against
reason_codes.structural: the information this analyst reads does not exist at this wall for any game
reason_codes.missing_inputs: the information this analyst reads has not landed for this game yet
reason_codes.thin_evidence: RETIRED 2026-08-01 — too little of this analyst's own slice was populated for this game. It no longer stops a read: the missing levers take their neutral value, contribute nothing, and the read is filed with its information completeness stated and its conviction reduced accordingly.
reason_codes.no_side: RETIRED 2026-08-01 — this analyst's channel came out exactly neutral. It no longer stops a read: the tie breaks to over, the probability is exactly 0.500 and the completeness is published as 0, so the card shows a side with visibly nothing behind it.

wall_coverage_table.note: WHAT EACH ANALYST CAN READ AT EACH WALL. Exactly one entry here is a structural claim about the sport rather than about the feed: the posted lineup does not exist before T-3h. It is MEASURED, not asserted — across every wall row since 2025-01-01 the fact table's lineup_known flags are 0.0000 at T-24h, T-12h and T-6h and 0.9974 at T-3h and T-1h, and the selftest re-measures it against the parquet on every run. Everything else is probed per game at pricing time, because 'the umpire is usually assigned late' and 'MLB has not named tomorrow's starter' are facts about a particular game, not rules.

analyst_v2_spec.multi_wall: EVERY ANALYST NOW PRICES EVERY WALL FROM T-24h FORWARD. Until 2026-07-31 the four priced a game only where its T-3h frame existed, which on a live evening board left more than half the games with four empty seats for most of the day — a regression against the standing requirement that every game carries a read from every analyst. Each analyst now has ONE MODEL PER WALL, fitted on that wall's own fenced training frame over exactly the levers whose information exists there, and games[].analysts fills each seat from the most informed wall that actually has a read, with the wall stamped on the seat. THE T-3h WALL IS UNCHANGED AND STILL OWNS THE RECORD: the T-3h wall fit reproduces the shipped T-3h artifact to 1e-9, record.analysts is still the T-3h read one row per game, and the per-wall reads are graded in their own ledger and published additively. FORCED COVERAGE IS STILL RETIRED and cannot return through this door: a read is written only when the analyst's own inputs are genuinely populated, a driver whose lever was imputed is stripped before anything can render it, the voice is gated off any sentence claiming information the read did not have, and an analyst below the evidence floor files NOTHING — the seat states why.
analyst_v2_spec.strategy_contract: games[].analysts[].strategy — the LIVE CLAUDE STRATEGY advisory, or absent. SHAPE {strategy_stance ('concur'|'caution'), strategy_caution (bool), strategy_note (one or two sentences, safe to render verbatim), cited_levers[], advisory_only:true, moved_the_pick:false, pick_side_unchanged, note, asof_utc}. WHAT IT IS: a Claude session that reasons about ONE analyst's own slice, its own reads for tonight and its own recent record. WHAT IT IS NOT: it does not and structurally cannot set a side, a probability, a line, a price or a stake — there is no such field in its response schema, the pricing fields are written write-once BEFORE any session runs, and the graded ledger is written from the untouched board row, so a session can never move an analyst's record in either direction. Every number in strategy_note is validated to be derivable from that game's own read row by analyst_takes.validate_take (the same validator the deterministic take-generator uses); a note that invents a number is dropped whole. strategy_caution is DOWNGRADE-ONLY: it may flag a game as less comfortable, never as more.
analyst_v2_spec.predicted_score_contract: games[].diamondedge.predicted_score — ATLAS's projected score. CHANGED 2026-07-31: the two numbers are now per-team EXPECTED RUNS (means), shown to one decimal, and they SUM TO `projected_total` by construction. They used to be per-team MEDIANS, which are integers and therefore collapsed most games onto 4-5, and which summed BELOW the projected total by 0.71 runs on average. SHAPE {away (float, 1dp), home (float, 1dp), source:'ATLAS', p_home_win, wall, projected_total, statistic:'expected_runs', note}. RENDERING: show one decimal — rounding to an integer reintroduces exactly the defect this fixed. It is a DISPLAY prediction, graded nowhere, and it is never a bet.
analyst_v2_spec.fence: TRAINING FENCE: every one of the four analysts is fit strictly on games dated 2025-01-01 through 2026-06-30 inclusive. No model sees a single row dated 2026-07-01 or later — the fence is asserted in dataset.assert_no_post_fence(), re-asserted by the trainer on every matrix it fits, and re-checked against every written artifact by the selftest. The live record for all four analysts begins 2026-07-01 and accrues forward.
analyst_v2_spec.seal_spend: THIS TRAINING WINDOW SPENDS SEALED DATE WINDOWS, KNOWINGLY. The program had sealed the 2024-04-01 -> 2026-04-30 confirmation corpus and the 2026-05-01+ cross-book holdout. The 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 training window runs straight through both, and Leon chose that deliberately in exchange for a clean forward evaluation window that starts the day training ends. CONSEQUENCE, STATED RATHER THAN BURIED: every number computed on the training window is IN-SAMPLE and carries NO evidential weight about future performance. The only honest evidence about these four analysts is the record that accrues from 2026-07-01 forward, on data no model has ever seen.
analyst_v2_spec.what_changed: THE FOUR ANALYSTS WERE RE-ARCHITECTED ON 2026-07-31. They used to be four different ENGINES over essentially the SAME market-anchored feature space, and the measurement showed it: all four sat between 48.6% and 51.0% on their own sides, the profile pass found ZERO measurable specialisms across 357 cells after correction, and no consensus configuration separated from chance across 2,972 games. They are now four THEORIES OF A BASEBALL GAME reading DISJOINT slices of the feature space — run prevention, run production, environment, price — enforced in code by analyst_v2.slices.FeatureGate. All four were retrained on 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 and all four records restart at 2026-07-01. The served pick and the champion product record are untouched by any of it.

definitions.label: The DiamondEdge Pick
definitions.what: The one pick we actually serve on this game: the champion's play if it has one, otherwise the model's best playable lean, otherwise a PASS.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every (date, game_pk) where the served hybrid produced a graded pick — champion play if present, else the model's best playable lean — exactly one row per game. GRADING: the row's own settled result at the real executable per-side price it was served at, on the line locked at first pitch; pushes return the stake and leave the ROI denominator. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-20 (the day the hybrid went live) forward only.

definitions.label: Champion engine
definitions.what: The champion engine's own totals play — its frozen pipeline plus the +EV gate at the real per-side price. It only speaks on games where its trigger fires; on every other game it has no view at all.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the champion engine itself rated PLAYABLE and that settled — one row per game (its highest-score playable wall). This is NOT the champion's published headline, which counts one row per game x STREAM at the last decision wall; the two populations are reconciled to a zero residual by champion_headline_residual(). GRADING: champion_v2's own graded ledger, untouched — gate at the median de-vig price, priced and settled at the best executable price at the same line. HEADLINE COVERS: forward paper ledger + live board from 2026-07-02 forward. The 2026-03-27..06-10 rolling-origin rows are a WALK-FORWARD BACKTEST and are reported separately.

definitions.label: V4 model grid
definitions.what: The v4 model grid's best playable totals lean on the game (+EV gate at the real price AND at least 1 point of model-vs-market disagreement).
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game where the v4 model grid had a playable totals row that settled — one row per game (core playable preferred over an expanded-band row, then highest score). This DELIBERATELY INCLUDES games the champion also played, which record.by_source.model does NOT: by_source counts only the games the model FILLED after the champion passed, so the two numbers differ and neither is wrong. GRADING: the grid's own graded rows — as-of-wall archive where a day has one, else the live graded ledger — at each row's real executable per-side price. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-06 forward (the first day the grid's live ledger graded anything).

definitions.label: Expanded band
definitions.what: The narrow near-miss band: full +EV gate cleared but the model/market disagreement is only 0.75-1.0 points. Live from 2026-07-24, stakes 0.5u, graded on its own.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: v4 model-grid rows that cleared the FULL +EV gate with model-vs-market disagreement of 0.0075-0.010, on games from the 2026-07-24 activation forward — one row per game. A strict SUBSET of model_v4: every expanded pick is also a model_v4 pick. GRADING: same rows, same real prices; staked 0.5u on the weighted line. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-24 only — the band is never applied retroactively.

definitions.label: Spread stream (run line)
definitions.what: The run-line (±1.5) side per game — a NEW stream, live from 2026-07-27, graded in public from day one, starting 0-0-0. Separate from the totals product in every record.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the run-line stream served from its 2026-07-27 activation forward — one graded row per game (the latest locked wall), stream-stamped rows only. A DIFFERENT MARKET from everything above: it never overlaps, sums with, or competes against any totals record. GRADING: the same board rails as totals — locked at first pitch, graded overnight at the REAL locked per-side run-line price, write-once, pushes returned. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-27 forward only — the stream starts 0-0-0; the pre-pivot spread era (retired 2026-07-07, adjudicated a research NULL) is history, never credit.

definitions.label: Physical run simulator
definitions.what: A fully-physical Monte Carlo of the game — every plate appearance drawn from empirical base-out transition tables tilted to the two lineups, starters, bullpens, park, weather and umpire as of each decision wall (T-24h through T-1h, re-priced as inputs firm up, each wall written once), with home-field advantage on, 20,000 games simulated — priced into P(over the posted total). The lean that grades is the latest wall locked at first pitch. Shown for transparency: on full-game totals it statistically TIES the market (its median lands within ~0.02 runs of the posted line; blend-vs-market p=0.28), so it is a tracked voice, never a bet.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the physical simulator priced from its 2026-07-28 activation forward — ONE graded row per game. The sim re-prices at each decision wall as inputs firm up (T-24h through T-1h from 2026-07-30; T-3h only before that), every wall write-once, and the row that grades is the LATEST wall locked at first pitch (earlier walls settle 'superseded', kept for audit, never counted). Sim-stamped rows from the stream's OWN ledger only. GRADING: the stated lean (the side implied by the sim's P(over) vs the market's) graded against the settled final at the LOCKED posted line, overnight, append-only — but this is a LEAN LEDGER, not a betting record: no units are ever staked, is_bet is false on every row, and stars are hard-capped at 1*. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-28 forward only — the stream starts 0-0-0, and the sim round's backtest (a statistical TIE with the market) is evidence about the engine, never credit.

status_vocabulary.PICK: this strategy would bet the game at the side/line/price shown
status_vocabulary.PASS: this strategy saw the game and declined — `side`/`line` still carry its lean, `reason` says why it is not a bet
status_vocabulary.NO_VIEW: this strategy produced no row for this game at all — stated explicitly, never silently omitted

strategies_spec.per_game_fields: games[].strategies[] = [{key, label, status, is_headline, is_served_source, side, line, vegas_line, price, stars, score, result, lead_time, locked, expanded_band, pass_why, reason}]. Exactly one entry per strategy per game, always all of them, in `order`. games[].pick is UNCHANGED and remains the single served pick; the is_headline entry mirrors it.
strategies_spec.inclusion_bar: A stream is listed only if it is computed every day into a real side/line/price decision AND has its own graded ledger. Closed research fronts (the ~60 tested-and-null mechanisms), spec-only bands, display selections like 'featured', and price-convention variants are NOT strategies and are not here.
strategies_spec.overlap_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING STRATEGIES. (1) THEY OVERLAP: the same game appears in more than one stream — expanded_band is a strict SUBSET of model_v4, and unified is whichever of champion/model_v4 won that game. Their records are NOT additive: do not sum n, units or ROI across strategies, and do not read 'four strategies' as four independent bets. (2) NO POST-HOC PICKING: choosing whichever stream currently looks best is not a strategy — with four overlapping streams on a few dozen graded picks, one of them looks good by construction. The only number that ever described a real bankroll is the served unified pick from its activation date forward. (3) LIVE vs BACKTEST are kept apart on purpose: each strategy's headline n/W-L-P here is its LIVE-SERVED picks only; reconstructed / walk-forward / would-have measurements sit in `backtest`, are labeled, and are never added to the live number. `combined_view` restates the union ONLY because the older published blocks (record.overall, record.by_source) report it — it is not a live record. (4) Sample sizes here are small. None of this is an edge claim.

performance_claim: Adaptive four-analyst selector, measured from strictly-prior trailing windows; no same-day or future result can choose that day's rule.
positioning: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK (Leon, 2026-07-20): one pick per game, one score, one star ladder, one record. Since 2026-08-02 the public total uses the locked daily four-analyst adaptive strategy: it can follow, fade or pass depending on the trailing pattern evidence. Champion/model streams remain diagnostic.

analysts.honest_note: WHAT THIS RECORD CAN AND CANNOT SUPPORT. The four models were fitted on 2025-01-01 -> 2026-06-30 and the record starts the day after, so it is genuinely out of sample and the leakage audit proves the fence four ways. But it is still only a few hundred games per analyst: at n=330 the 95% interval on a hit rate is roughly +/-5.4 points, which is wider than any edge worth having. The STANDING HYGIENE RULE therefore applies in full — no model-performance conclusion is drawn from this record, in either direction, and a rate below 50% is no more a finding than a rate above it. What the re-architecture is actually for is DECORRELATION: the four now read disjoint features and their sides agree only about as often as coin flips would, which is what makes their disagreement worth rendering.

desk_calls.note: THE DESK'S CALLS, GRADED IN THEIR OWN LEDGER. This is NOT a betting record and must never be summed with one, shown beside one as a comparison, or described in units: a call has no price and no stake, so it has no ROI. It counts one row per game — the desk's view at the most informed wall it reached — and it exists to answer one question the product could not previously ask: when the desk says something, is it right? A CALL IS NOT A BET. This is the desk's directional view on the game — what it actually thinks — built from the four analysts' own reads, equal-weighted. It is NEVER staked, it NEVER enters games[].pick, it is never counted in the product record, and it cannot be sized. Whether we are betting this game is a separate question with a separate answer, at `we_are_betting` / `bet_action`, decided by the price gate alone and unchanged by anything here. desk_calls.contract: THE DESK-CALL CONTRACT (2026-08-01). WHAT IT IS: a directional view on EVERY game — side, conviction, a probability and a one-line argument — built from the four analysts' own reads, equal-weighted (the measured house position: desk_fit's walk-forward refused a fitted combiner). SERVED AT games[].diamondedge.desk_call. WHAT IT IS NOT: A CALL IS NOT A BET. Whether we are betting a game is decided by the price gate alone and is served, unchanged, at games[].diamondedge.action (PLAY / LEAN / AVOID, where AVOID still means and only means that no bet was served) and at games[].pick. Every call row hard-stamps is_bet=False, staked=False, stake_units=None, playable=False, suggested_units=None, take=False, stars=None and pick_side=None, and those stamps are re-asserted on every write and every read; the module may write only its own three stores and refuses every served board and product ledger by name. THE VOCABULARY, and a reader can never mistake one axis for the other: `desk_call.call` is the CALL (STRONG/CLEAR/SLIGHT + OVER/UNDER), `desk_call.state` fuses both axes (CALL_AND_PLAY / CALL_AND_LEAN / CALL_NO_BET / CALL_NO_GAME / PENDING), `we_are_betting` is the bet in one boolean, and `why_no_bet` names the reason when it is false. GRADING: the graded product remains games[].pick and ONLY games[].pick. The desk's calls are graded in their own append-only ledger, one row per game at its most informed wall, from 2026-08-01, with no units and no ROI because a call has no price.

board_coverage.multi_wall_note: SEATS FILL FROM THE MOST INFORMED WALL THAT HAS A READ. Until 2026-07-31 the four analysts priced a game ONLY where its T-3h frame existed, which left more than half of a live evening board with four empty seats for most of the day. They now price every wall from T-24h forward, each from a model fitted at that wall over the information that actually exists there, and a seat shows the best read available with the wall stamped on it. THIS IS NOT FORCED COVERAGE: no read is manufactured, the evidence floor refuses a read whose inputs are not populated, and a seat with nothing behind it stays empty and prints the reason.

It used to manufacture a fallback read for whichever of the four dismantled engines had frozen nothing on a game, which guaranteed a full board by construction. The v2 stream prices a game only where its T-3h feature frame exists, so a no-read is a real statement about the feed for that game and is counted here rather than filled in from a different model.

desk_fit.model: P(over) = sigmoid( logit(p_mkt) + b + SUM_a w_a * d_a ), d_a = logit(p_over_a) - logit(p_mkt_a), 0 where analyst a has no read. The market log-odds are a FIXED OFFSET, so w_a asks only whether that analyst's disagreement with the number adds anything the number does not already carry. Ridge-penalised (lambda pre-specified, not scanned), fit by IRLS, standard errors from the penalised Hessian.
desk_fit.baselines: EQUAL WEIGHT = the same model with one shared coefficient on the mean divergence of the analysts who read the game, fit on the same window — so the comparison isolates differential weighting. MARKET = p_mkt untouched.
caveats: THE CORPUS RESTARTED ON 2026-07-01 AND THAT IS THE POINT. This block used to be computed over ~11,800 games of a pre-re-architecture reconstruction of four DIFFERENT models. Those weights could never have been applied honestly to these analysts, so the history was dropped rather than carried forward. What is here now is a few hundred games and it says so; a thin honest window beats a deep irrelevant one.

Almost every frame is `reconstructed_oos` basis: the four models were built on 2026-07-31 and priced July after the fact. Every read is genuinely out of sample against a 2026-06-30 training fence, but it was not SERVED before the game. The live share grows by one slate a night and nothing is ever restated.

THE EVIDENCE FLOOR IS MET AND THE WALK-FORWARD IS NOT. The trailing window now clears both floors, so four weights CAN be fitted — but the walk-forward that decides whether to USE them only starts once 150 games of history exist, which on a corpus this young costs the first half of it. So the contrast is scored on a handful of slates and its interval is wide enough to contain both a real improvement and a real regression. Adopting weights on it would be adopting noise; the gate stays shut and the interval is printed rather than described.

No analyst shows a positive edge on its own side and none is claimed (the four sit between 43% and 51% at n=332, an interval of about +/-5.4 points). What the re-architecture bought is DECORRELATION — disjoint feature slices, side agreement down from 0.84-0.89 to 0.51-0.57 — which is the property a combiner would need in order to have anything to combine. Whether it carries edge is a question only the forward record answers.
desk_fit.honest_note: THE ROLLING DESK FIT IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. It re-fits every night over the trailing 30 days how each analyst's DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PRICE has related to results, scores that fit WALK-FORWARD (fit strictly on days before the day it is scored on, never on the days it is scored on), and compares it to two baselines: equal weighting and the price itself. Fitted weights are only ever ADOPTED when the walk-forward improvement over equal weighting has an interval strictly better than zero AND the window carries enough reads to fit four weights. When it does not — which is the state today — the desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS and this block says so with the numbers, because presenting a fitted weight whose interval straddles the equal-weight baseline is presenting noise as insight. Nothing here gates, sizes or grades a bet: the +EV gate and the star system remain the only things that make a bet, and the combined probability is display only, graded nowhere.

desk_fit.headline: Fitting the four analysts' disagreement-with-the-price over a rolling 30-day window does NOT beat weighting them equally: walk-forward over 211 games and 16 days the log-loss difference is -0.00027 (95% CI [-0.00140, +0.00076]). desk_fit.model: P(over) = sigmoid( logit(p_mkt) + b + SUM_a w_a * d_a ), d_a = logit(p_over_a) - logit(p_mkt_a), 0 where analyst a has no read. The market log-odds are a FIXED OFFSET, so w_a asks only whether that analyst's disagreement with the number adds anything the number does not already carry. Ridge-penalised (lambda pre-specified, not scanned), fit by IRLS, standard errors from the penalised Hessian.
desk_fit.baselines: EQUAL WEIGHT = the same model with one shared coefficient on the mean divergence of the analysts who read the game, fit on the same window — so the comparison isolates differential weighting. MARKET = p_mkt untouched.
caveats: THE CORPUS RESTARTED ON 2026-07-01 AND THAT IS THE POINT. This block used to be computed over ~11,800 games of a pre-re-architecture reconstruction of four DIFFERENT models. Those weights could never have been applied honestly to these analysts, so the history was dropped rather than carried forward. What is here now is a few hundred games and it says so; a thin honest window beats a deep irrelevant one.

Almost every frame is `reconstructed_oos` basis: the four models were built on 2026-07-31 and priced July after the fact. Every read is genuinely out of sample against a 2026-06-30 training fence, but it was not SERVED before the game. The live share grows by one slate a night and nothing is ever restated.

THE EVIDENCE FLOOR IS MET AND THE WALK-FORWARD IS NOT. The trailing window now clears both floors, so four weights CAN be fitted — but the walk-forward that decides whether to USE them only starts once 150 games of history exist, which on a corpus this young costs the first half of it. So the contrast is scored on a handful of slates and its interval is wide enough to contain both a real improvement and a real regression. Adopting weights on it would be adopting noise; the gate stays shut and the interval is printed rather than described.

No analyst shows a positive edge on its own side and none is claimed (the four sit between 43% and 51% at n=332, an interval of about +/-5.4 points). What the re-architecture bought is DECORRELATION — disjoint feature slices, side agreement down from 0.84-0.89 to 0.51-0.57 — which is the property a combiner would need in order to have anything to combine. Whether it carries edge is a question only the forward record answers.
desk_fit.honest_note: THE ROLLING DESK FIT IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. It re-fits every night over the trailing 30 days how each analyst's DISAGREEMENT WITH THE PRICE has related to results, scores that fit WALK-FORWARD (fit strictly on days before the day it is scored on, never on the days it is scored on), and compares it to two baselines: equal weighting and the price itself. Fitted weights are only ever ADOPTED when the walk-forward improvement over equal weighting has an interval strictly better than zero AND the window carries enough reads to fit four weights. When it does not — which is the state today — the desk uses EQUAL WEIGHTS and this block says so with the numbers, because presenting a fitted weight whose interval straddles the equal-weight baseline is presenting noise as insight. Nothing here gates, sizes or grades a bet: the +EV gate and the star system remain the only things that make a bet, and the combined probability is display only, graded nowhere.
